song.name: Endless Night
song.plot: Anya completes the seal, trapping herself and Nyktoros in the deepest Void — the symphony of despair as the endless night closes over her.
song.analysis: Anya completes the seal, trapping herself and Nyktoros in the deepest Void. Full structure restored (kept song); light anchors grafted: the Void's symphony, the Sealing, the Rift.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: Dark night Cold and silent Echoes of cries Soul defiant Tears fall Moonlight drowns Broken dreams Lost in crowns
section.reworked: Dark night Cold and silent Echoes of cries Soul defiant Tears fall Moonlight drowns Broken dreams Lost in crowns

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Whispers in the void Shadows lurch Sanctuary torn No place of church Cloaked in sorrow Bathe in sin Twisted fate Let the end begin
section.reworked: Whispers in the void Shadows lurch Sanctuary torn No place of church Cloaked in sorrow Bathe in sin Twisted fate Let the Sealing start

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Symphony of despair Endless night Crushing hearts No will to fight Melancholy's embrace Violent strain In this anguished realm We remain
